axiom_table.name: Dimension
axiom_table.statement: Spectral dimension of (A, H, D) is a non-negative integer d; eigenvalues lambda_n of |D| satisfy Weyl asymptotics lambda_n ~ n^(1/d).
axiom_table.invocation_site: Heat-kernel expansion Tr(exp(-t D^2)) ~ sum_k t^((k-d)/2) a_k; a_4 is the k=4 coefficient in d=4 mod 8 convention.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: Without dimension axiom, heat-kernel index k of Seeley-DeWitt expansion is undefined; a_4 is structurally tied to d=4 conv.

axiom_table.name: Regularity
axiom_table.statement: a and [D, a] lie in the smooth domain of delta^n = [|D|, .] for all n (CCM-2007 auto-satisfied on finite A_F).
axiom_table.invocation_site: Symbol of heat kernel requires smooth a; Seeley-DeWitt coefficients are local integrals of smooth jets of D^2.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: Without regularity, the heat kernel trace expansion fails to converge / loses asymptotic form.

axiom_table.name: Finiteness
axiom_table.statement: The space H_inf = intersect_n Dom(D^n) is finitely-generated projective module over A. On finite A_F: dim H_F < inf.
axiom_table.invocation_site: Trace_F in a_4 = integral tr_F(E_2) dvol on M4 x F requires finite-dim trace over H_F = C^32.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: Without finiteness, tr_F diverges; g_3^2 coefficient extraction (which pins alpha_s) requires a convergent sum over F.

axiom_table.name: Reality (J)
axiom_table.statement: Anti-unitary J: H -> H with J^2 = epsilon, J D = epsilon'' D J, J gamma = epsilon' gamma J. KO-6 row: (eps, eps', eps'') = (+1,+1,-1).
axiom_table.invocation_site: Fermionic action (1/2)<J psi, D psi> doubles to full Dirac action; reality enforces absence of fermion-doubling / Majorana structure which affects Yukawa traces in c (Tr Y^*Y) feeding a_2, but a_4 uses (Y^*Y)^2 trace (d-term of CCM-2007 eq. 3.14). Without J, (Y^*Y)^2 trace structure is not well-defined.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: Reality is load-bearing for the fermionic closure that produces the d-term in a_4 (Higgs quartic) via coupling to right-handed neutrinos.

axiom_table.name: First-order
axiom_table.statement: [[D, a], J b J^{-1}] = 0 for all a, b in A. This is the 'bimodule' compatibility of D with left/right A-actions.
axiom_table.invocation_site: Inner-fluctuation decomposition D -> D + A + JAJ^{-1} separates into gauge (from M4 sector) + Higgs (from F sector). a_4 produces Yang-Mills Tr F^2 terms FROM the inner fluctuation. Without first-order, no clean YM extraction, no g_i^2 coefficients, no alpha_s.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: First-order is the gauge-sector backbone of a_4. Breaking first-order (even weakly as in Bochniak-Sitarz 2021) re-routes the a_4 structure; alpha_s depends on the 'strict' first-order decomposition.

axiom_table.name: Orientability
axiom_table.statement: There exists a Hochschild cycle c of degree d with pi(c) = gamma (volume form / chirality on F).
axiom_table.invocation_site: Orientability selects the volume form / chirality grading, not the eigenvalue content of D. a_4 = Tr f(D^2/Lambda^2) is symmetric in lambda_n^2; does not depend on the sign / orientation of the grading cycle.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: a_4 coefficient extraction uses tr_F over the UNGRADED trace (even Seeley-DeWitt coefficient, k=4 even), so the orientation cycle is NOT invoked. Physical picture: alpha_s depends on g_3^2 (gauge coupling magnitude), not on the chirality sign.

axiom_table.name: Poincare duality
axiom_table.statement: The intersection form on K-theory K_*(A) x K_*(A) -> Z is non-degenerate.
axiom_table.invocation_site: Poincare duality is a K-theoretic TOPOLOGICAL statement on the algebra A; a_4 is a LOCAL spectral-action integral. The eigenvalue spectrum of D does not invoke K-theory of A in its computation.
axiom_table.structural_dependency: PD is used to CLASSIFY admissible finite algebras (CCM-2007 Theorem 2.1) -- i.e. to establish that A_F = C + H + M_3(C) is the UNIQUE choice. But GIVEN A_F, the a_4 coefficient on (A_F, H_F, D_F) is computed without invoking PD. Classification axiom, not computation axiom.
